and I showed them the risings of the stars and their settings hard to discern, where Stobaeus Ecl. phys. 1,2 has ὁδούς [roads] instead of δύσεις [settings]. δύσεις is rightly read, in which Achilles Tatius in his Introduction to Aratus agrees, as the opposition to ἀντολάς [risings] demands. The epithet δυσκρίτους [hard to discern] belongs to both nouns.
